test_title: SSC CHSL Exam 2023 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 Nov, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECT statement with regards to vitamins.

options.text: Plants can synthesise almost all vitamins.
Most of the vitamins cannot get synthesised in sufficient amount in our body.
Some bacteria in the gut do not produce vitamins.

solution:
The correct answer is __**some bacteria in the gut do not produce vitamins**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Plants can synthesize almost all vitamins, making them a **primary source of vitamins** for many organisms.
 
• Most vitamins cannot be synthesized in sufficient amounts in our body, necessitating their intake through diet.
 
• Vitamins are organic compounds essential for normal growth and nutrition, usually required in small quantities in the diet.
 
• Some bacteria in the gut do produce vitamins, such as **Vitamin K and certain B vitamins**, contributing to the host's nutritional needs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Vitamins are classified into two categories: **fat-soluble (A, D, E, K) and water-soluble (B-complex and C)**.
 
• Deficiency of vitamins can lead to various health issues, such as** scurvy (Vitamin C deficiency), rickets (Vitamin D deficiency), and beriberi (Vitamin B1 deficiency)**.
 
• The human body requires vitamins for various biochemical and physiological functions, including immune function, energy production, and bone health.
 
• While the body can store fat-soluble vitamins, water-soluble vitamins need to be consumed more regularly as they are not stored and are excreted in urine.
